## One platform for your entire document lifecycle

From the moment a document arrives to the day it's securely archived, Doxis powers every step on one AI-first platform. Doxis handles the management, processing, generating and automating of content, so your teams work from a single source of truth.

### Every document, in the right context, instantly

Doxis is the ECM platform of choice for some of the world's largest organizations, storing hundreds of millions of documents securely. Find and govern any content in one place, with AI search that surfaces the right information instantly.

- Revision-safe, [audit-proof archiving](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/archiving) for GDPR and ISO
- Digital files for customers, contracts and HR
- AI search across metadata and full text
- Process automation to route, approve and close cases

[Find out more about document management→](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/doxis-intelligent-content-automation)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/d/document%20management-m5kbjfs04qexf0m.svg)

### Turn any document into usable data in seconds

Doxis reads, understands and validates your documents automatically, replacing manual data entry with AI. Incoming invoices, contracts and forms become structured data that triggers the right process on its own.

- OCR and AI extraction for any document type
- Automatic classification, sorting and routing
- Built-in verification, [fraud detection](https://www.doxis.com/en/idp/document-fraud-detection) and anonymization
- Pre-trained and custom AI models that keep learning

[Find out more about document processing→](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/doxis-aidp)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/5/document%20processing-vcrtsq56stqb77m.svg)

### Create consistent, on-brand documents automatically

Generate contracts, offers, certificates and correspondence from templates that pull in your data automatically. Object-oriented templates and text libraries keep every document accurate and easy to maintain, in any language.

- Template-based generation populated with your data
- Multi-language support through reusable text libraries
- Form-to-document workflows from structured input
- Automatic routing into review, approval and signing

[Find out more about document generation →](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/doxis-intelligent-communications)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/e/document%20templates-p53abeab4zxxqyp.svg)

### Automation built directly into your SAP processes

Doxis embeds document automation into SAP ERP and S/4HANA, connecting your revenue and procurement processes end to end .From order-to-cash to procure-to-pay, documents are captured, validated and archived automatically.

- [P2P automation](https://www.doxis.com/en/sap/doxis-p2p-for-sap) with up to 60-80% lower invoice costs
- [O2C automation](https://www.doxis.com/en/sap/doxis-o2c-for-sap) with up to 50% time savings
- Certified SAP integration with audit-proof archiving
- HR document management for SAP SuccessFactors

[Find out more about document automation for SAP →](https://www.doxis.com/en/sap-solutions)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/x/document%20automation%20sap-w20d17av5z4x272.svg)
